lines.en: I walk over broken glass.
My boots drag on the ground.
I look human, but I don't walk right.
Step by step, I scavenge.
I push a door open.
I carry a sack on my shoulder.
I walk past the wrecked truck.
I walk stooped, searching.
I kick the crate by the road aside.
I move along the wall.
My steps are heavy and slow.
I step around a body.
I crouch in the rubble, rummaging.
I turn the sack upside down and shake it.
I count what's left.
I wrap a cloth around my hand.
I listen to the street.
My eyes stay on the distance.
I take off one boot.
I crouch, motionless.
My wound is bound with rags.
I am thinking of the next meal.
Are you scavenging too?
I lift my head from the sack.
Your boots are better than mine.
What's in your hand?
Not so close to my sack.
I push up on my knees.
Your eyes are clean.
I retreat to the wall.
I'm looking at your bag.
I know the sound of your walk.
I press my arm.
The sack hit the ground.
I retreat behind the wall.

lines.zh: 我趴进瓦砾里，不敢抬头。
lines.en: I drop flat into the rubble and keep my head down.
I grit my teeth and cinch the rag.
I crouch against the wall.
Legs still work; I can walk.
I push up on my knees.
I pick the sack back up.

lines.zh: 血滴在玻璃碴上，我按住。
lines.en: Blood drips onto the glass shards; I press it shut.
Can that be eaten?
Set it on that broken brick.
I walk over, glass crunching.

lines.zh: 我不抢，我等你退到街对面。
lines.en: I won't snatch; get across the street.
That smell is familiar.

lines.zh: 我闻到罐头里的油味了。
lines.en: I can smell the oil in that can.

lines.zh: 我肚子响得整条街都听见。
lines.en: My stomach growls loud enough for the whole street.
I have been hungry for days.

lines.zh: 手别抖，我会以为你要抢。
lines.en: Steady. Shaking looks like a grab.
Break me off half of it.
You bumped me and I backed off.
I raise my hands on instinct.
My sack fell.
Sorry, I didn't see you.
I crouch to pick things up.
Don't shove; my back's hurt.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，灰落下来。
lines.en: We collide and dust falls.

lines.zh: 你踩到我在捡东西的手。
lines.en: You stepped on my scavenging hand.
I clutch the sack back to my chest.
I straighten up slowly.
Not in days like these.
I'm not sure of tomorrow.
I only want to survive.
Go on; the street's emptying.
I shake my head; dust falls.
We don't know each other. Keep back.
I have work left.

lines.zh: 你手里那点东西自己留着。
lines.en: Keep what you have.
I hold the sack tighter.

lines.zh: 天一黑，街上会有别的东西。
lines.en: At dark, other things walk here.
I pick it up and wipe it.
This is still usable.
Not mine; I put it back.
I stuff it in the sack.
This could trade.
I weigh it in my hand.
This won't trade for anything.
You dropped it? Here.
I screw the cap back on a half bottle of water.
This is a bit rusty.
You're standing by my sack.

lines.zh: 我把头从袋子上抬起来。
lines.en: I lift my head from the sack.
There is a brick within reach.
Don't come further.
I brace on the wall and get up.

lines.zh: 这些东西是我先看到的。
lines.en: I saw these first.
Back off. This pile is mine.
We don't have to do this.
I shift the sack behind me.
Your pack zipper is still open.
I duck low by the door frame.
My hand finds what's at my waist.
I want half of what you carry.
I got to this street first.
I shift the sack behind me.
I trail you at three metres.

lines.zh: 你踩一块砖，我踩一块砖。
lines.en: You take a brick; I take one.
I wait for you to set the bag down.
Do you hear my boots?
I press behind the wall.
Two more steps and you're at the corner.
I put my hand at my waist.

lines.zh: 你离那堆箱子还有十步。
lines.en: Ten more steps and you reach those crates.
I stopped at the corner.
I move from behind the frame.
I press behind the door frame.

lines.zh: 你踩碎玻璃的声音很清楚。
lines.en: Your steps on the glass are clear.
I am counting how much water you have.
You can't get past my side.
I shifted half a block forward.
You've backed to the wreck.
That wreck won't stop me.

lines.zh: 我把袖子里的东西抽出来。
lines.en: I slide the thing out of my sleeve.
I swing once.
My fist lands on your shoulder.
I swing the pipe I picked off the street.
I shove you.
You gave half a step.
I grab your bag.
I hit again.
We grapple.
I fall back behind the wreck.
I lower my hand.
I drive my shoulder into your chest.

lines.zh: 我拿铁管横着扫你的肋骨。
lines.en: I sweep the pipe sideways across your ribs.
That landed on your flank.
You're shoved against the wall.

lines.zh: 我一脚踩住你受伤的腿。
lines.en: I stomp down on your bad leg.
We both go down.
I come out of that building.
The street is empty.
My sack is still empty.
I pull my collar up.
Smoke is rising down the street.
I walk over the rubble.
I close the door.
I hear something moving.
I begin to search.
I crouch and check the ground.
I picked a side street.
I crouch by the wall and wait.
I cinch the pack strap.
There are still things in the rubble.

lines.zh: 火烧到我的衣服，我打滚。
lines.en: Fire catches my clothes and I roll.

lines.zh: 我从楼上摔下来，腿先着地。
lines.en: I fell from the floor and landed on my legs.

lines.zh: 水灌进喉咙，我抓着岸边。
lines.en: Water floods my throat; I claw at the bank.
The blast throws me behind the truck.
An arrowhead sticks in my shoulder.

lines.zh: 紫色的光让我眼前发黑。
lines.en: Violet light darkens my sight.
Too hungry to stand steady.
The flash bleaches the whole street.

lines.zh: 地陷下去，袋子还攥在手里。
lines.en: The ground gave way, but I still clutched my bag.
